methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched via WebFetch for Cloudbeds, Mews, Little Hotelier, WebRezPro, innRoad, Hotelogix, eviivo and Sirvoy. RoomRaccoon's official page returns HTTP 403 and third-party prices are mutually inconsistent (Entry reported $188/$236/$300), so all RoomRaccoon monthlyUsd are null. Cloudbeds and Mews are genuinely quote-only (no published self-serve prices). innRoad publishes only an explicit '~$150/month' estimate, not a rate, so its plans are null. Hotelogix does NOT publish prices on its official page (contact-sales); the previously listed $80/$120/$180 figures were third-party 10-room reconstructions of a per-room model and have been nulled. Little Hotelier renders prices via a dynamic per-room calculator; the Pro starting price $109 is corroborated by Capterra. WebRezPro ($10/unit tiered) and eviivo ($50/$125) are published directly. Sirvoy Free/$15/$54 confirmed on the official page and Capterra. accessedAt 2026-06-15.
